title: Launch a digital learning product in two markets
badge: Illustrative simulation — not a live GWD operation
objective: Design and launch a new digital learning offer in two selected markets.
assumptions: The product offer and target markets are hypothetical.
No real customer data, revenue, budget or team capacity is used.
Candidate capabilities are selected from a source catalogue and require evaluation before deployment.

steps.title: Validate market and audience
steps.humanGate: Approve target segment and learning problem.

steps.title: Design offer and learning journey
steps.humanGate: Approve offer, curriculum and learner promise.

steps.title: Prepare launch content
steps.humanGate: Approve claims, creative and public messaging.

steps.title: Configure sales and support journey
steps.humanGate: Approve data collection, consent and customer process.

steps.title: Review economics and risk
steps.humanGate: Approve budget, legal terms and launch authorization.

steps.title: Launch and evaluate
steps.humanGate: Human launch approval and post-launch review.

economics.notice: No revenue, margin, budget, conversion or customer figures are assumed. Values may be entered later by a visitor and must remain labelled as scenario inputs.
